Everything above about "The Price is Right™" comes from the Texas Lottery's own published numbers. We only do the counting.

2782.body:
The key fact about "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" is how its eight prize levels are built. The prize money leans toward many smaller prizes. Games built like this give out wins often, but rarely large ones. Prize counts change daily, but this design does not.

If "$1,000,000 Diamond Deluxe" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
